high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account "@engineers_feed," which is associated with "World of Engineering." The tweet provides historical information about the Wright Brothers' first flight at Kitty Hawk. It states that although the famous first flight took place on December 17, 1903, the Wright Brothers did not publicly demonstrate their technology until August 8, 1908. The tweet includes a black-and-white photograph of two men walking side by side. Both men are dressed in formal attire, including suits, bowler hats, and ties.
